content:
Grateful to have been a part of the Organising Committee for this insightful program at our law school, where we had the privilege of hosting the Founding Vice Chancellor of MNLU,Mumbai.

Truly grateful for the opportunity to contribute to and be a part of this initiative. ⚖️✨
comment: Academic initiatives like these also highlight the importance of connecting legal education with institutional realities, where exposure to experienced leaders can shape how future professionals view the role of law schools.
